reason: NONE. First thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is a dollar a day, and my Nature Made 200 mg runs about 39 cents. The 'Every batch lab-tested' line with a QR is nice, but anyone can print that, and I don't see NSF or USP on the box.
objection: Two and a half times what I pay now per serving, from a brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A named lab is better than nothing, but it is still the brand picking its own lab.
would_change_my_mind: NSF or USP certification, plus a price near 60 cents a serving or less (around $18 a box) and a few hundred real reviews.
